verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that payouts are issued once the balance meets a threshold in your 'account currency', which hints that settlement happens in the merchant's own currency. Polar acts as merchant of record in countries without Stripe. Nothing in the pack shows customers being charged in their local currencies, or how currency conversion is handled or disclosed. Missing for 10: evidence of local-currency presentment and charging for customers, documented FX conversion rates/fees and transparency, explicit multi-currency settlement-to-bank details, independent corroboration.
